specimens.name: Sealed twin-tube fluorescent ceiling fixture
specimens.notes: Two enclosed fluorescent tube forms behind one sealed diffuser; isolated and unlit.

specimens.name: Slim under-cabinet fluorescent task fixture
specimens.notes: Slim isolated linear task fixture with compact mounting tabs; no surrounding cabinet.

specimens.name: Articulated halogen machine task lamp
specimens.notes: External wiring is gone, but the source shows a two-link articulated arm with an intermediate elbow; the spec requires one short articulated arm segment and pivot base.

specimens.name: Sealed rectangular inspection/work lamp
specimens.notes: Sealed rectangular work lamp with ribbed lens and adjustable bracket; no baked glow or projected light.

specimens.name: Small red LED panel indicator
specimens.notes: Reads as a large deep prismatic lamp/indicator housing with four-corner fasteners rather than a small late-1990s LED package in a compact panel bezel.

specimens.name: Small amber LED panel indicator
specimens.notes: Same oversized deep lamp-housing language as specimen 05; insufficient E2 small-LED progression from E1.

specimens.name: Small green LED panel indicator
specimens.notes: Same oversized deep lamp-housing language as specimens 05-06; reads closer to E1 indicator hardware than compact E2 LED packaging.

specimens.name: Six-LED functional status-strip module
specimens.notes: Exactly six physical lenses in two separated red/amber/green groups of three; no legends or active glow.

review_method: Second direct vision inspection of the exact SHA-bound untouched PNG against the merged machine spec and E1->E2 replacement contract; corrected a premature PASS recorded before close inspection of arm geometry and indicator scale/language.
rejection_reasons: Specimen 03 has two articulated arm links instead of the single short arm segment required by the machine spec.
Specimens 05-07 read as oversized deep lamp-style indicators rather than compact late-1990s LED panel packages, so the E1->E2 lighting progression is not strong enough.
